text:
lene (partnerships): Quick heads-up — NitroCloud (HW vendor) + AtlasSI want a joint marketplace listing for Gateway + Orchestrator bundle, plus a coordinated announcement. Can we run a short playbook sync? :rocket:

mike (eng-runtime): +1. We need to confirm supported hw images (A100 vs H100) and whether the orchestrator will be packaged as Helm chart or AMI.

ajay (product): Timeline? AtlasSI wants GA+marketplace the week after next if possible. That feels tight.

carla (solutions): Actionable checklist from my side: integration test matrix, deployment manifests, onboarding doc, demo script. Need eng runtime to confirm KV cache behavior on NitroCloud instances.

mike (eng-runtime): I'll validate kernel selections and quantization profiles on Nitro H100 in the next 48h. Also need to verify the runtime fallback when the specialized kernel isn't available.

lene (partnerships): For marketplace packaging we need: SKU definition, billing mapping, logo/art assets, security questionnaire answers, and a private offer flow for Atlas customers. Tom — can sales confirm procurement constraints?

tom (sales): AtlasSI customers primarily purchase via private offers on NitroCloud marketplace. We need a single SKU for "Redwood Gateway + Orchestrator (NitroCloud certified)" and optional "Dedicated Support" add-on. Procurement ok with standard contract language but legal will want a data flow diagram.

legal-bot: Please attach the data flow diagram and the DPA variations. Also confirm that no customer data is stored by Redwood in the integration path (we need an explicit statement).

carla (solutions): Demo script draft (short): 1) Provision NitroCloud instance with certified AMI 2) Deploy Helm chart for orchestrator 3) Run sample orchestrated job using LangChain connector 4) Validate metrics in Redwood Console.

ajay (product): Callout: we must support LangChain and LlamaIndex adapters out-of-the-box for the demo. Add a simple sample repo and a one-click deploy link.

mike (eng-runtime): Sample artifact naming for marketplace: 
```
redwood/orchestrator:nitrocloud-v1.2.0
redwood/gateway:nitrocloud-v1.2.0
```
We'll publish those to our registry and provide checksums for Marketplace verification.

lene (partnerships): Marketing asks: coordinated blog + joint press, brief customer success case study, and a webinar. Sarah — can you own the announcement cadence?

sarah (marketing): Yep. Suggest soft launch to pilot customers on Monday, public marketplace listing + blog on Thursday, webinar next week. Need 2 customer quotes for the blog. I'll draft a short joint announcement template for legal review.

carla (solutions): Integration tests needed: 1) end-to-end deploy on Nitro H100 2) SSO integration with Atlas SAML 3) billing metering validation 4) failover to hosted model variant. Who owns each?

mike (eng-runtime): I'll own #1 and #4. Need Eng-Infra help for #3 (metering).

lene (partnerships): Next steps: 
- Mike validate artifacts & fallback (by EOD +2)
- Carla produce demo script + integration test matrix (by EOD +3)
- Tom prepare SKU and private-offer draft (by EOD +3)
- Sarah draft announcement cadence + collect quotes (start today)
- Legal-bot to review DPA + announcement copy (ASAP)

tom (sales): I'll sync with Atlas procurement today and confirm private offer mechanics. If they want reseller tagging, we can do that on marketplace listing.

legal-bot: Received. Please attach the joint announcement draft in this thread when ready so I can review.

lene (partnerships): One more technical note — AtlasSI asked for an "orchestrator certification" badge. We probably show a verified badge on the marketplace tile after automated test pass + SI sign-off. Thoughts?

mike (eng-runtime): Implement a cert-runner that executes our smoke tests and posts results to S3. Marketplace automation can check the signed result. I'll prototype.

carla (solutions): I'll sketch the pass/fail criteria for the badge. Keep it light: deploy success, latency under X, KV correctness, and SSO auth flow.

ajay (product): If feasible, let's bake the certification checks into our CI so updates trigger re-cert runs. Reduces manual overhead for future releases.

lene (partnerships): Great. I'll capture these notes and convert to a playbook doc after this thread. Can everyone drop final blockers here by EOD? :pray:
